source.title: Installation and usage - mdformat 1.0.0 documentation
source.description: Install the CommonMark formatter via `pipx`, adding GFM/MyST support through `inject` plugins; format in place or `--check`, tune with `--wrap`/`--number`; Python `mdformat.text()`/`file()` API; `pre-commit` hook.

source.title: Configuration file - mdformat 1.0.0 documentation
source.description: A `.mdformat.toml` resolved up the file tree sets `wrap`, `number`, `end_of_line`, `validate`, `extensions`, and `codeformatters`; CLI args override it; Python 3.13+ adds Unix-glob `exclude` patterns.

source.title: Plugins - mdformat 1.0.0 documentation
source.description: Three plugin categories — code formatters (`mdformat-black`), parser extensions (`gfm`, footnotes, admonitions), and misc (`mdformat-pyproject`) — each installed then explicitly enabled via `codeformatters=` or `extensions=` in the Python API.

source.title: Formatting style - mdformat 1.0.0 documentation
source.description: The normalised Markdown style, tuned to minimise review diffs: ATX headings, `-` bullets, non-incrementing `1.` ordered lists, fenced code blocks, bottom-sorted reference links, and semantic-line-break word wrapping.
